name: coreutils-small-20

typed_c_bridges.reason: Keep only GNU printf's native x86 long-double construction, parsing, and variadic xprintf call behind raw-byte typed boundaries; format parsing, quoted-character policy, diagnostics, and other conversions remain translated Rust.

c_normalization.reason: Carry the native long-double object as exact raw storage and declare the three narrow typed boundaries.
Preserve GNU's quoted-character, locale, warning, errno, and validation policy while storing the parsed native value as raw bytes.
Delegate only the ABI-sensitive variadic long-double call while retaining GNU's directive construction and argument selection.
Evaluate the checked multiplication eagerly and accumulate its Boolean overflow result without a bool-to-integer compound assignment.
Evaluate the checked addition eagerly at the destination width and accumulate its Boolean overflow result explicitly.

selection_policy: Translate GNU printf in full and isolate only the native x86 long-double representation and variadic ABI that Rust and C2Rust cannot express.
